stories.title: 3-state defensive v0022 identity-collapse migration (BL-020 unblock)
stories.completionNotes: Rex/Agent1 Sprint 56. Rewrote v0022 _repointSummaryFk to the Atlas 3-STATE per-table branch keyed on the APPLIED summary_id FK (information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE), NOT the drifted ORM FK: (1) FK->drive_summary => drop stale + ADD->drives.drive_id; (2) FK->drives => no-op; (3) NO FK => ADD-only, skip the drop. Removes the pre-BL-020 line ~343 bug that collapsed states 2+3 and fatalled on state 3 (SchemaProbeError 'the expected FK is missing') -- exactly drive_statistics on the drifted prod schema where create_all never auto-named the FK the ORM assumes. Added _addDrivesFk() shared ADD-path with an _orphanSummaryIdCount() LEFT-JOIN anti-join guard on BOTH state-1 and state-3: a non-zero orphan count fails loud with the count (MigrationError) BEFORE any ADD -- never ADD an FK that will not validate (0 for existing rows, v0018 subsumed drive_summary.id INTO drives.drive_id identical values). Collapse-table set enumerated: drive_statistics [state-3, no FK] + drive_derived_signals [state-1, stale FK->drive_summary from v0017]; drive_annotations docstring CORRECTED -- exists on prod but has NO summary_id column => genuine no-op (was mislabeled 'no such table'). Per Atlas Q2 NO drive_summary.id->drives hard FK added. Idempotent/forward-safe: replay on canonical DB = state-2 everywhere. TESTS (hermetic FakeRunner, no SSH/MariaDB): replaced test_fkMissingEntirelyRaises (encoded the old buggy fatal) with TestRepointThreeState (state-1 drop+add, state-2 no-op, state-3 ADD-only-no-drop, state-3 orphans fail-loud-no-ADD, state-1 orphans fail-loud) + TestApplyDriftedProduction (real BL-020 shape: stats state-3 ADD-only, derived state-1 drop+add). 31 passed, ruff clean in-loop. PM/DEPLOY GATE (BENCH-ONLY, owed at integration on chi-srv-01): run v0022 upgrade against the live drifted DB after 0018-0021 applied -- verify drive_statistics.summary_id ends with exactly one FK->drives.drive_id, no line-~343 fatal; couple with US-462 preflight guard. mypy strict = PM integration gate (not installed in dev).
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: before writing any branch, read the current v0022 body AND query information_schema for the applied summary_id FK on EVERY collapse table (fixture + prod-mirror) -- enumerate the real tables + their actual FK state; do not assume the ORM's FK

[ATLAS RULING 2026-07-13] v0022 probes each collapse table's APPLIED summary_id FK and branches 3-STATE per table: (1) FK->drive_summary => drop+re-point to drives.drive_id; (2) FK->drives => no-op; (3) NO FK => ADD-only to drives.drive_id, skip the drop. Removes the line ~343 bug (states 2+3 collapsed, fatals on state 3) NOTE [ATLAS GAP-2]: v0022 is a custom MigrationRunner step (src/server/migrations + scripts/apply_server_migrations.py), raw SQL via _runServerSql -- NOT Alembic op.*

applied to EVERY collapse table (>=drive_statistics [state 3, no FK] + drive_derived_signals [state 1, stale FK->drive_summary]); drive_annotations comment corrected (exists on prod, no summary_id col => genuine no-op); per Atlas Q2 do NOT add a drive_summary.id->drives hard FK

idempotent / re-runnable: resumes clean at v0022 (0018-0021 applied); second run is a no-op; forward-safe on an already-canonical DB; on runtime orphans vs drives.drive_id, fail loud with the count (never ADD an FK that won't validate)
tests: state-3 (no FK)->ADD, state-1 (stale FK)->drop+re-point, state-2 (already->drives)->no-op, 0-orphan precondition; targeted + synchronous + committed in-iteration

stories.title: Applied-schema FK/CHECK guard -- pre-migration A-10 drift tripwire
stories.completionNotes: Rex/Agent1 Sprint 56. New src/server/migrations/preflight.py: assertDriveIdentityFks reads the APPLIED schema via information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE (reuses v0022 _fkNameReferencing -- define-once; NEVER create_all/ORM-metadata = the US-459 theater trap Atlas flagged), fails with PreflightError(MigrationError) naming table+column+expected FK target. DRIVE_IDENTITY_FKS registry built from v0022 constants (drive_statistics + drive_derived_signals summary_id -> drives.drive_id). WIRED into scripts/apply_server_migrations.runRegistry BEFORE the migration set (reg built once, preflight then runAll). TWO-LAYER per Atlas GAP-1: (a) HERMETIC verdict tests (always run) prove RED on a missing expected FK, GREEN when all present, LOUD on unreachable probe; (b) LIVE preflight wired in, fails the deploy on drift, SKIPS HONESTLY (SELECT 1 reachability probe) when no MariaDB. CRITICAL design choice to avoid re-shipping BL-020: the 'before the migration set' wiring would DEADLOCK the BL-020 resume-deploy (v0022 is PENDING and is itself what CREATES these FKs), so the wired entry assertAppliedMigrationFkTopology LEDGER-GATES the expected set by schema_migrations -- asserts only FKs whose sourceVersion is already applied. On the resume-deploy (schema_migrations=0021, v0022 pending) it defers; it fires only when an ALREADY-applied migration's promised topology regressed (true A-10 tripwire). Updated tests/server/test_migrations.py::test_main_runAll_noopOnFullyMigrated (fully-migrated DB now carries the FKs -> its fake runner answers the KEY_COLUMN_USAGE probe). TESTS: 84 passed (preflight 21 + runner/migrations 32 + v0022 31 regression), ruff clean in-loop. conditionalOutcome: TD-055 (create_all-masks-drift, Option A testcontainers third leg) exists ARCHIVED at offices/pm/archive/intake-records/tech_debt/; handed PM an inbox note (2026-07-13-from-rex-us462-td055-third-leg-deferral.md) to annotate the third-leg deferral. PM/DEPLOY GATE (bench-only): after v0022 applies on live drifted DB, next --run-all preflight verifies both summary_id FKs -> drives.drive_id present; drifted DB fails fast. mypy strict = PM integration gate (not installed in dev).
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: before adding the guard, audit where US-459's applied-schema guard is wired in apply_server_migrations AND which drive-identity FKs the pending migrations require -- mirror that placement + reporting shape

[ATLAS GAP-1 TWO-LAYER, mirror US-459 tests/server/test_data_source_applied_schema_accepts_foreign.py:39-52] (a) HERMETIC verdict test: preflight goes RED on a missing expected drive-identity FK, GREEN when all present

[ATLAS GAP-1] (b) LIVE preflight WIRED into apply_server_migrations BEFORE the migration set: FAILS the deploy on drift; when no MariaDB is reachable it SKIPS HONESTLY (never reports pass -- the Windows bench case). Hermetic-test-only + silently-passing live wiring = the exact green-over-broken-deploy that IS BL-020
[ATLAS Q3] guard reads the APPLIED schema via information_schema (FK topology + relevant CHECKs), never create_all / ORM-metadata-only; failure message names table + column + expected FK target
